content: विप्रलब्ध {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Deceived, cheated; ऐक्याद्वयस्य ऋतवानिति विप्रलब्धः <ls>Bhāg. 1. 15. 19</ls>. .²2 Disappointed. .²3 Hurt, injured. .{@-ब्धा@} A woman disappointed by her loverʼs breaking his appointment; (one of the several classes of a Nāyikā in poetic composition); she is thus defined in <ls>S. D.</ls>:-- प्रियः कृत्वापि संकेतं यस्या नायाति संनिधिम् . विप्रलब्धेति सा ज्ञेया नितान्तमवमानिता .. <ls n="S. D.">118</ls>.
